# secopsctl exclusions

Imperative findings-refinement ops (enable/disable/archive) for custom + curated detections — config-as-code is `pull/push rule_exclusions`

## exclusions deploy

MUTATING (guarded): enable, disable, or archive a rule exclusion

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl exclusions deploy <id> (--enable | --disable | --archive) [flags]
```

```text
Patch one findings refinement deployment by id. `--enable` also unarchives
the refinement; `--archive` disables it and marks it archived. Guarded: dry-run
by default, --yes to apply. Re-pull afterwards so local mirrors live.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--archive` | bool | false | disable and archive the rule exclusion |
| `--disable` | bool | false | disable the rule exclusion |
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--enable` | bool | false | enable and unarchive the rule exclusion |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## exclusions get

Read-only: get one rule exclusion (incl. its deployment state)

```text
secopsctl exclusions get <id>
```

## exclusions list

Read-only: list rule exclusions (findings refinements) with id, type, query

```text
secopsctl exclusions list
```
